gloss: to exterminate; to get rid of (pests)

definitions.gloss: to exterminate; to eradicate; to get rid of (pests, vermin, weeds)
definitions.explanation: To eliminate unwanted organisms such as insects, rodents, weeds, or other pests. Used for both professional pest control and everyday removal of pests.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゴキブリ→ゴキブリ：05131_gokiburi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{駆除|くじょ}する。
⟦{害虫|がいちゅう}→害虫：06430_gaichuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{駆除|くじょ}する⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まいた。
examples.english: I sprayed pesticide to get rid of the pests.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}して→依頼する：21376_irai⟧⟦シロアリ→シロアリ：29728_shiroari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{駆除|くじょ}して⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had a professional company come to exterminate the termites.

notes:
Compound of {駆|く} (drive away) + {除|じょ} (remove). Specifically used for eliminating unwanted living things — pests, vermin, invasive species, weeds, etc. Not used for removing inanimate objects or abstract concepts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{害虫|がいちゅう}{駆除|くじょ}→害虫駆除：25154_gaichuukujo⟧: pest extermination
- ネズミ⟦{駆除|くじょ}→駆除：16374_kujo⟧: rat extermination
- ⟦{駆除|くじょ}→駆除：16374_kujo⟧⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧: pest control company
- ⟦{駆除|くじょ}→駆除：16374_kujo⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: extermination work
- ⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{駆除|くじょ}する: to eradicate weeds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{退治|たいじ}する→退治する：25396_taijisuru⟧: to exterminate (more colloquial, also used figuratively for defeating enemies)
- ⟦{除去|じょきょ}する→除去する：22368_jokyosuru⟧: to remove (broader; used for stains, obstacles, substances)
- ⟦{撲滅|ぼくめつ}する→撲滅する：25553_bokumetsusuru⟧: to eradicate (used for diseases, crime — more formal and larger scale)
